regions.today: Dry and warm today with sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 16 to 22 degrees. Mostly light to moderate south-west winds, possibly fresh at times along coasts.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with clear periods. A few mist or fog patches forming in light or variable southerly breezes. Lowest temperatures of 6 to 12 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Sunday will bring another warm day with spells of sunshine. Meanwhile, sea fog may persist for a time on southern coasts in the morning.Highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees, in just light southerly or variable breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Saturday, high on Sunday.
